digest.component_or_area: LLM provider abstraction and parity bar
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 are invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 with both bare and temperature=0 sampling parameters.

The same logical request payload reaches both Anthropic and Bedrock providers with byte-identical system prompts, messages, and tool definitions, differing only in model-id envelope and provider-specific formatting.
The tool set (comment_ticket, list_directory, read_file, resolve_symbol, search_files, show_ticket) offered to the model is identical across providers, both class slots.
Provider routing on the Bedrock-configured arm is provider-clean with zero non-Bedrock provider calls across 84 case-runs per slot (verified via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally).

The temperature=0.0 capability difference between sonnet and opus is symmetric and explicit—opus withdraws temperature on both providers via the supports_temperature: False override in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES, not driven by provider asymmetry.
Bedrock structured-output validity is 100% across 90 case-runs per slot with zero runtime errors and latency at or better than direct Anthropic (standard 9.9% faster, frontier within 0.1%).
